_comment: M3 传感器/执行器分离（#4499，spec #4495）。清单内的文件是 pipeline 的控制信号：unit 的 diff 碰到任意一个，落地脚本（engine/rule-lane.sh，挂在 land-direct-main.sh 检查链上）拒绝落地。改动只能走 supervisor 规则通道：ZF_AGENT_NAME=supervisor 提交，且改动提交带 Rule-Replay: <回测报告路径> trailer，报告 schema 为 zf-control-rule-replay/v1（engine/mac-autopilot/rule-replay.mjs 产出，存 docs/agents/rule-replays/）且 falseStops 为 0。本清单自身也是规则文件。lessons/* 与 engine/state/incident-guards.json 不在清单内：它们由 M6 的教训机制（land-direct-main.sh 的 lesson 折叠）单独管辖。 2026-11-05 (ruling zenoforge-limited-allow-research-first): the list also names the gates, review rules, evaluators, pin, watchdog, rollback and credential files, plus the check (rule-lane.sh) and its test. A key ending in / protects that whole directory; the scheduler itself stays open to units. In a repo that vendors the pack (ZF_PACK_REL), every engine/ key is also protected under that prefix.

files.engine/state/scheduling-policy.json: 统一调度策略与单元状态机（八类策略各标执行脚本与裁决；#4655）
files.engine/state/stopgaps.json: 带解除条件的临时规则
files.engine/state/mechanism-registry.json: 机制沉默上限与事件匹配模式
files.engine/mac-autopilot/config.template.jso: 配置里的止损、门禁和预算参数（live 配置的仓库来源）
files.engine/mac-autopilot/node_health.py: 指标定义和阈值、健康标准
files.engine/mac-autopilot/NODE-HEALTH.md: 健康标准的唯一表述文档
files.tools/merge-pr-bootstrap.sh: gate: engine PR merge helper (test bootstrap check)
files.engine/supervisor/hooks/: gate: supervisor command, claim and ruling hooks (directory)
files.engine/mac-autopilot/scheduler.d/review-: review rules: reviewer prompts and engine-override gate
